ABOUT.TITLE: ABOUT US
ABOUT.WHO_TEXT: We are a church that worships and prays day and night, finds, develops and releases people, and brings heaven to earth.
ABOUT.VISION_1: People who know that God loves them passionately
ABOUT.VISION_2: and who in turn love God passionately
ABOUT.VISION_3: and where everyone discovers and trains their passions and gifts
ABOUT.VISION_P1: All of this is expressed in: find – develop – release!
ABOUT.VISION_P2: By “bringing heaven to earth” we mean what Jesus says in Matthew 6:10: your kingdom come, your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. So God's will is: heaven on earth.
ABOUT.VISION_P3: Jesus explains that his kingdom, the reign of God (heaven), is at hand. God's world is within reach. His solutions and answers, his healing power, his love, his ability to set free. God is the answer to all the problems of this world, of our societies, of our families and of our personal lives.
ABOUT.VISION_P4: God wants to transform entire nations, set them on fire with passion for his Son and pour out blessing into every area of life and every sphere of society.
ABOUT.VISION_P5: This is what we dream of, and this is what we want God to use us for.
ABOUT.BELIEVE_P1: We believe that God is. That he is present, that he is near, that he is good, that he can be experienced. In the middle of Berlin or anywhere else.
ABOUT.BELIEVE_P2: That the ancient message of the Bible is relevant today and can be experienced today.
ABOUT.BELIEVE_P3: We also believe that God still speaks prophetically today, and that He has plans for Berlin. There are many prophetic promises over our city of Berlin. God has spoken that it will be a city where many people will experience healing. Healing of body and soul.
ABOUT.BELIEVE_P4: We believe in revival and the transformation of entire nations!
ABOUT.BELIEVE_P5: As a church we want to be part of this, we expect it, and we are reaching out for it!
ABOUT.BIO_CHRISTOPHE: Elder and senior leader. He is married to Miriam. Together they have three children.
ABOUT.BIO_MARC: Elder and pastor for children and youth. Responsible for IT and head of diekreative Akademie. Marc is an IT specialist and is married to Steffi.
ABOUT.BIO_MATTHIAS: Elder and head of administration and personnel. Together with Rike he pastorally oversees the area of "volunteers".
ABOUT.BIO_RIKE: Pastor for families. Married to Matthias. Together they have four children. They lead our marriage ministry "Gute Beziehungen" (good relationships).
ABOUT.BIO_KARSTEN: Pastor for arts and music. Leads worship, multimedia and communications. He is married to Marisa. They have three children.
ABOUT.BIO_MARISA: Married to Karsten. She is an educational scientist specialising in daycare quality and family support.
ABOUT.BIO_JUTTA: Leads our diaconal ministry and the Alpha course. She also supports the coordination of our lifeGroups. Jutta has four grown-up children.

V204.TITLE: V2.04
V204.TEXT: The door opener has a new security feature: the door can now only be operated on-site within a certain radius. To use this feature, location services must be enabled for the app, or the app must be connected to the guest Wi-Fi network at the prayer house. The app now allows users to select their campus location to view the corresponding events. Our course platform has been integrated into the app with automatic login for registered users. The app is now also available in English (may be changed in the settings).

V203.TITLE: V2.03
V203.TEXT: Our icons got a new look. Login with two-factor authentication is now supported. On Android the problem that you could not log in again has been fixed.

V202.TITLE: V2.02
V202.TEXT: Small bug fixes and, for registered users, an additional prayer calendar in Hohen Neuendorf.

V201.TITLE: V2.01
V201.TEXT: Small bug fixes and, for registered users, access for prayer in Hohen Neuendorf.

V200.TITLE: V2.00
V200.TEXT: A new generation of the app is ready! Apart from the fact that the app is based on new source code, users are surely more interested in what's new in the interface. Sermons are now searchable and can be played in the background. The app now also runs in landscape mode (handy for tablets). For registered users (with a diekreative Churchtools account) further features are unlocked, such as door openers for the house of prayer and the barrack, as well as information for the ministry team.

V108.TITLE: V1.08
V108.TEXT: Revamped media library. You can now download sermons including sermon scripts to your device (preferably via Wi-Fi), so you can save data on the go or listen to sermons in airplane mode. Many events now have further information, which can now also be shown on iOS (previously Android only). Some bugs were fixed as well (e.g. lifeGroups are displayed correctly again). We look forward to your feedback and would be happy about a rating in the Play Store / App Store.

V107.TITLE: V1.07
V107.TEXT: From now on you can edit the home screen and arrange the tiles yourself. The media library loads faster - only the latest 20 sermons are shown. With the 'MORE' button you can show the remaining sermons.

V106.TITLE: V1.06
V106.TEXT: *CHRISTMAS UPDATE* ;-)   An update was long overdue. Now it's finally here. New are the events overview and the option to also check in family members for the service via QR code. On every page showing current information, you can refresh the display by swiping down. There were also some bug fixes and optimisations.

V105.TITLE: V1.05
V105.TEXT: no April Fools' joke! Finally there's a bigger update again. The app now also runs on iPad, and for Android users the back button now works (especially for Basti ;-) ) If there is a sermon script for the service, it can be shown directly in the app under "Services". From there you can also start the YouTube livestream directly or listen to the service via the Zoom app (useful for visitors on site who can hear the sound better that way or listen to the English translation).

RELEASE.TITLE: official app release
RELEASE.TEXT: At our prayer service the app is released and promoted for iOS and Android!

APPSTORE.TITLE: first version in the App Store!
APPSTORE.TEXT: Just in time for the end of the year, the first (preview) version of the app appears in the Apple App Store ;-)

TROPFEN.TITLE: slow and steady..
TROPFEN.TEXT: Things get a bit quiet around the app on the outside. But a lot is happening in the background. Login to Churchtools, door opener, releasing and taking over prayer shifts.. all of this works now! The app is now really close to its first release!

PARTY.TITLE: App Release Party
PARTY.TEXT: By now the alpha version of the app is ready. That has to be celebrated in Anja's allotment garden! And of course the app is presented live. And the last tasks are handed out. There are still a few cosmetic fixes, and the connection to the door opener, prayer calendar etc. still has to be built.

HACKATON.TITLE: App Hackathon
HACKATON.TEXT: In the middle of the summer break we "hole up" in beautiful Gussow, in the guest house of the Stadtmission, and get to work. They were busy days that were a lot of fun and joy. And the result is impressive. Even though, unfortunately, we couldn't install the app on our smartphones on the last day yet. Designing and programming an app takes more time than some might think.
HACKATON.TEXT2: Thanks to everyone involved! You are by far the best! ;-)

KICKOFF.TITLE: App Kickoff Meeting
KICKOFF.TEXT: Here we go! Enough crazy people from our church have come together to join our 4-hour Zoom kickoff meeting and contribute their ideas and skills. First teams are formed and first wishes for the app are put into words. And it is already decided that we want to organise an app hackathon during the summer break, where we develop the app together!

TEAM.TITLE: A project team is born
TEAM.TEXT:
Andrea hears about our idea and brings in a developer - Christian - and also spontaneously offers to sponsor part of the costs for the app, because she believes in our project!
So the three of us (Marc, Mirine, Christian) meet via Zoom in the middle of the COVID lockdown and quickly agree that the app should be born right out of our community. That means we don't want to outsource the app but design and develop it completely ourselves!

IDEE.TITLE: first idea
IDEE.TEXT: Marc: As a church we want to find, develop and release people's potential. As a former IT guy I wondered whether we could also be creative in the field of IT within Christianity and lead the way as pioneers. There was a first meeting and exchange of ideas with Mirine. Lots of good ideas came together, but how do we put them into practice? Hire a development company? Dive into the subject ourselves?..
